content: Framer Motion (Motion) scales to hundreds of animated elements when animations are limited to transform/opacity (GPU-composited), but production regressions appear when motion runs alongside frequent state updates, virtualized/large tables, chart re-renders, or SSR hydration — causing frame drops on scroll/filter/pagination. Recommended guardrails: animate transform/opacity only (not width/height/top/left), use AnimatePresence sparingly with short exit animations, and gate motion behind useReducedMotion for accessibility and to have an escape hatch if perf regresses.
